item.text: Thank you for taking care of the plants while I was away. The basil looks healthier than it did before, and I’m grateful that you noticed the window was leaking. Your message was thoughtful, and placing a towel there helped prevent things from getting worse. I really appreciated your attention to these small but important details. It was reassuring to know everything was in good hands while I was gone.
